除非两相情愿，暂时分房，
为要专心祷告方可；
以后仍要同房，免得撒但趁着你们情不自禁，
引诱你们。
夫妻不可彼此虧負，
除非兩相情願，暫時分房，
為要專心禱告方可；
以後仍要同房，免得撒但趁着你們情不自禁，
引誘你們。
Don’t deprive one another
unless it is by consent for a season
that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer
and may be together again
that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

Do not keep back from one another what is right
but only for a short time
and by agreement
so that you may give yourselves to prayer
and come together again; so that Satan may not get the better of you through your loss of self-control.
